column5: The Battle of Savo Island, August 9th, 1942: Strategical and Tactical Analysis, Part I
column11: Read two ways. Chapters I to V as the HyperWar transcription (https://www.ibiblio.org/hyperwar/USN/rep/Savo/NWC/index.html), which stops there. The whole book as the scan DTIC ADA003037 on archive.org, through its OCR text, which misreads many letters and some digits (SC radar appears as 8 C, 0136 as 0156). Page numbers in locators are read from the OCR and can be one page out. Its Japanese side rests on captured records and the 1945 interrogations
